answer: Client-liability hiring bond: a client opening a hollow slot on the ridge board locks 80 credits and pays a 20 fee per worker hired, bonded to one client, one worker and one epoch in the dune archive. The ridge auditor recomputes the dune archive against prior work; a fake worker burns the client's bond and voids the hire. The k-th fake hire costs 80 at risk plus 20 fee, so 1,000 risk 80,000 and sink 20,000; one bond backs one hire, so no bulk discount. A rented-client ring fails: the rented client loses its bond. One honest hire costs 100 and recovers 80 after an epoch.
